evidence.finding: The first-party README explicitly documents Cursor CLI as a community-tested drop-in agent: claude_command=agent and claude_args=--force --output-format stream-json. evidence.title: ralphex: cmd/ralphex/main.go
evidence.locator: opts Serve/Host/RALPHEX_WEB_HOST; executePlan/buildLogger; pkg/web/server.go; README Docker wrapper
evidence.finding: The CLI deliberately serves a network monitoring dashboard using --serve --host or RALPHEX_WEB_HOST. The installed host owns agent execution and the browser is an SSE observer, so a separately deployed operator host/Docker host can continue work with the client laptop disconnected. No Ralphex-operated cloud runtime is implemented in the inspected execution paths.

evidence.title: ralphex: README.md
evidence.locator: Docker-in-container support and host Docker socket security note
evidence.finding: The optional Docker wrapper documents that macOS Docker has VM isolation, in contrast to the Linux host-socket security warning. This is the operator Docker-on-macOS VM boundary, not a per-task Ralphex VM provisioning service.

evidence.title: ralphex: pkg/plan/parse.go
evidence.locator: Plan, Task, Checkbox, TaskStatus; ParsePlanFile; README Plan Creation; processor task loop
evidence.finding: Ralphex creates or imports Markdown plan files independently of an execution session. Task sections and persisted checkboxes are parsed into product task objects and pending/active/done states; users can edit the file, exit after planning, and execute/resume it later. Completed plans are archived. This is a native file-backed task workflow, not an external tracker link or chat-only list.

evidence.title: ralphex: pkg/web/server.go
evidence.locator: Complete HTTP route registration; static/app.js; cmd/ralphex/main.go; config defaults; processor prompt expansion
evidence.finding: The inspected client/runtime route and command surface has terminal-started execution plus a read-only SSE monitoring dashboard, with no inbound scheduled/event execution, human prompt submission via shared sessions, human role/SSO layer or analytics opt-out switch. Dashboard diffStats contains only changed-file/addition/deletion counts, not proposed-code hunks. Review prompts expand reviewer roles into the selected harness native Task/spawn_agent tools; no Ralphex-owned session delegation tool is supplied. The optional finalize prompt rebases/organizes commits without a PR operation.
